forum_report_def_harassment: Attacks or intimidation toward others with abusive language or deliberately and repeatedly disrupting conversations, including revealing others' personal or sensitive information. This includes unwanted romantic advances, sexual remarks and or requests for sexual favors.
forum_report_def_fraud: Illegal activities, malware, or promotion of illegal products or services.
forum_report_def_spam: Irrelevant, repetitive content intended to artificially increase engagement, or other inappropriate promotional content.
forum_report_def_misinfo: False content or information about the post, that present untrue facts or events as though they are true or likely to be true.
forum_report_def_self_harm: Promotion, encouragement or any portrayal of self-harm or suicide.
forum_report_def_sexual: Nudity or other content that's sexual in nature.
forum_report_def_fake: Inaccurate or misleading representation of a person or organization.
forum_report_def_hateful: Attacks or incitement of violence against individuals or groups based on their actual or perceived traits, or any other speech that promotes hatred.

about_para_1: MAPPED is part of the Traditional Martial Arts for All (TMA4ALL) project - a groundbreaking European initiative dedicated to making all traditional martial arts accessible and inclusive for everyone (Project 101133802 — TMA4ALL).
about_para_2: We believe that all traditional martial arts can transform lives through physical, psychological and social development, regardless of the style. In fact, research consistently shows that the martial arts coach is the most important factor in improving health, well-being and quality of life among practitioners, regardless of the martial art itself. Our mission is to support all traditional martial arts coaches in creating safe, empowering sessions that welcome people of all abilities, backgrounds, ages and disabilities.
about_para_3: Developed through collaboration between leading inclusive martial arts organisations and universities across Europe, MAPPED is the first fully accessible and inclusive app designed specifically for grassroots martial arts coaches. Whether you're an aspiring coach or an experienced instructor, MAPPED provides the tools, support and community you need to deliver high-quality inclusive martial arts sessions.
about_para_4: Join our growing international network of coaches who are using traditional martial arts to improve lives and build stronger, more inclusive communities.
